chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed three separate ʿumrahs, all of them in Dhu al-Qaʿdah: an ʿumrah for which he entered into iḥram from ʿUsfān, and it was the ʿUmrah of al-Ḥudaybiyah; and the ʿUmrah of al-Qaḍāʾ, for which he entered into iḥram from al-Juḥfah; and an ʿumrah for which he entered into iḥram from al-Jiʿrānah, and it was after he returned from al-Ṭāʾif after the campaign of Ḥunayn.

key_terms.الْجُحْفَةِ: al-Juḥfah, the miqat/place from which iḥram was entered
key_terms.الْجِعْرَانَةِ: al-Jiʿrānah, the place from which iḥram was entered after Ḥunayn
key_terms.الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ: al-Ḥudaybiyah, the site of one of the Prophet’s ʿumrahs

ai.seo_question: How many ʿumrahs did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله perform, and from where did he enter iḥram for them?
ai.summary: This report states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed three distinct ʿumrahs, all in the month of Dhu al-Qaʿdah. It identifies each ʿumrah by its place of iḥram and historical setting, preserving a concise record of the Prophet’s practice.
